results.question: If I cancel 10 days before my course starts, what refund do I get?
results.expected: A 50 percent refund, or a free transfer to another date (7 to 13 days notice).
results.answer: If you cancel 7 to 13 calendar days before the course start date, you will receive a 50 percent refund, or you may choose a free transfer to another date [1]. Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 10 business days of the request [1].
results.reason: The chatbot correctly identifies the 50 percent refund or free transfer option applicable to a cancellation made 10 days in advance.

results.question: What discount do we get if 5 people from my company enroll in the same course?
results.expected: 15 percent off per student (group discount for 3 to 9 people).
results.answer:
You receive a 15 percent discount per student when 3 to 9 people from the same organisation enroll in the same course [2]. Please note that only one discount can be applied per enrollment and discounts cannot be combined [2]. 

If you would like, an enrollment advisor can contact you to help set up your team's enrollment.
results.reason: The chatbot correctly states that groups of 3 to 9 people receive a 15 percent discount per student.
